proposed_facts.reason: Canonical definition and extern declaration lack const. The two callback rows and state selections support the dispatch explanation; local callbacks mutate item fields, not the table. The correction appropriately avoids compiled placement claims.

The function has a non-static void(Item_GObj*) definition and a matching header declaration. It restores velocity and enters state 0, and the falling collision callback passes it to shared collision processing. Removing the private-linkage characterization is justified.

Canonical item code separates movement fields from the global animation accessor. Airborne drag updates current velocity without writing cached speed. The independently inspected fighter consumer installs the returned animation on x2184 and uses animated X scale to interpolate scale endpoints.
